# Rework running workflows & merge queue

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

Closes #710

Fixes the required `test` job not being run in merge queue.
Also reworks the test vectors to use single workflow file and a matrix.

On top, I've decided to run less stuff in merge queue to speed up merging. We risk bugs that are introduced by auto-merging parallel PRs, but I think it should be super rare, and it's acceptable for dev speed.

## Walkthrough

Consolidates multiple per-suite GitHub Actions workflows into a new matrix-based workflow at .github/workflows/vectors-test-suites.yml and removes several individual vector workflows (.github/workflows/vectors-jam-conformance-070.yml, vectors-jam-conformance-071.yml, vectors-w3f-070.yml, vectors-w3f-davxy-070.yml, vectors-w3f-davxy-071.yml, vectors-w3f-davxy-072.yml). Adds or documents the merge_group trigger in build workflows (.github/workflows/build-qa.yml and comments in build-docker.yml and utils-benchmarks.yml). No changes to exported/public code entities.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes

- Inspect matrix entries mapping suite → gp_version → script → expected output for correctness.
- Verify conditional steps (caching, optional checkout of test vectors) and artifact upload-on-failure behavior were preserved in the consolidated workflow.
- Confirm concurrency/group settings and environment variables (TEST_VECTORS_REF, NODE_VERSION) behave as intended with the matrix.
- Check for leftover references to removed workflow filenames.
